#### Intro:

+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Action potential         | - Allows rapid, co-ordinated signalling                               |
|                          | - Rapid depolarisation followed by repolarization                     |
|                          | - Ion channels cycle through resting → activated → inactivated states |
+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Determinants of ion flux | - Channel permeability: voltage dependent                             |
|                          | - Electrochemical gradients                                           |
|                          |   - Na^+^ and Ca^2+^ into cell, K^+^ out of cell                      |
|                          |   - Mainly due to Na^+^K^+^ATPase                                     |
+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Definitions:

+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Threshold    | - Membrane potential at which a self-propagating action potential is triggered |
+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Excitability | - \% of Na^+^ channels returned from inactivated to resting state              |
|              | - ∝ rate of rise phase 0                                                       |
+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Irritability | - Closeness to threshold                                                       |
+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
